caption: The drawing features a single statue of a male figure standing upright and facing slightly to the viewer's left. The figure wears a knee-length tunic with a grid-like or patterned design, a short-sleeved shirt, and a decorative chest harness that crosses diagonally from the left shoulder to the right waist. The legs are covered with what appear to be fitted, patterned coverings, and the feet rest on a rectangular base. The figure's left arm bends at the elbow so that the forearm stretches forward, while the right arm rests along the side. The head is adorned with a tightly wrapped headpiece that has a long segment trailing down the back. The statue is rendered in shades of gray and muted brown, giving the surface a weathered stone or metal appearance. The background of the drawing is plain, light beige, and untextured. The lower right corner of the image has small printed text reading "SITAE VITLS."
title: Cigar Store Indian "Trapper"
